attributes.name: footer payment icon presentation
attributes.definition: How payment-method logos/badges are presented in the footer.

values.definition: Payment logos shown as small badges/images in a single horizontal row, no container.
Payment icons are grouped inside a white rounded box, e.g. on a dark footer.

attributes.name: social icon container shape
attributes.definition: The shape/treatment of the container surrounding social media icons.

values.definition: Icons sit inside circles with an outline/border only.
Icons sit inside solid (e.g. white) filled circles.
Bare icons with no surrounding shape.

attributes.name: icon/badge size
attributes.definition: Relative scale of icon and badge images.

values.definition: Icons/badges rendered small relative to surrounding content.
The same image reused at different sizes in different places.
